description: This PHP script sets up and tests the environment for functional testing within the OrangeHRM project. It includes configuration validation, plugin setup via symlink, loader registration, cache and database service registration, and filesystem permission checks.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Handles configuration constants and settings for the OrangeHRM application.

classes.name: ServiceContainer
classes.description: Provides dependency injection container access for registering and retrieving services.

classes.name: CacheService
classes.description: Provides caching mechanisms within the application.

classes.name: Doctrine
classes.description: Implements ORM functionalities, notably providing the entity manager.

classes.name: DatabaseBackupService
classes.description: Handles database backup operations, including creating savepoints.

methods.name: createInitialSavepoint
methods.description: Creates an initial database savepoint for testing.
